title: 第149章 第三次公演
slug: 电竞世界冠军选秀c位出道
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

他径直走向贵宾观赛区的角落，那里已经坐着一个人。

林石也戴着低调的黑色帽子，坐姿松弛，正低头看着手机消息，神色平静。

见到VaX落座，林石微微抬眼，轻轻颔首示意。

林石看着很忙，两人便也没有多余的交谈，安静并肩坐着，互不打扰。

贵宾区格外安静，陆陆续续有人走进来，默契地安静找位置坐下。

没过几分钟，林石的手机突然持续震动起来，来电界面不停闪烁。

他低头扫了一眼来电备注，轻声起身，怕手机铃声打扰到场内其他人，特意压低动作，侧身接起电话，同时轻声对着身侧的VaX交代了一句：“我出去接个电话，马上回来，你先坐。”

VaX微微点头，没说话，依旧维持着低头静坐的姿势。

林石抬步快步离开贵宾区，走到贵宾室外接电话。

没多久，一个身影重新在他身侧坐下。

他没看，以为是林石去而复返。

但他没想到，对方竟然微微靠近，俯身在他耳边说了一句话。

VaX身体一僵，猛地回头看去，却只见对方离开的背影。

他僵坐在原地，久久回不过神。

“你怎么了？”

接完电话回来的林石握着手机，疑惑地看着他。

“没、没事。”

VaX匆匆摆过头，掩饰住眼中的震惊，声音有些止不住的发抖。

林石没有过多探究，此时，舞台上随机播放着一公和二公舞台的大屏渐暗。

下一秒，全场灯光骤然熄灭。

黑暗中，有人低声说了一句：“开始了。”

偌大的场馆瞬间陷入一片漆黑，喧嚣声也渐渐压低，一千六百名观众默契地安静下来。

数秒的黑暗过后，一束明亮的光猛地刺破黑暗，精准落在舞台正中央。

三公开场表演，由本次节目导师关柳带领他的组合Flame登台。

这是他们组合传唱度最高的一首代表作，音乐前奏瞬间炸响，节奏极具力量感。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

He walked straight to the corner of the VIP viewing area, where a person was already sitting.

Lin Shi was also wearing a low-key black hat, sitting in a relaxed posture, looking down at the messages on his mobile phone with a calm expression.

Seeing VaX sitting down, Lin Shi raised his eyes slightly and nodded gently.

Lin Shi looked very busy, so the two of them had no unnecessary conversation and sat quietly side by side without disturbing each other.

The VIP area was extremely quiet. People came in one after another and silently found a seat to sit down.

Within a few minutes, Lin Shi's cell phone suddenly started vibrating continuously, and the incoming call screen kept flashing.

He lowered his head and glanced at the call note, then stood up quietly. He was afraid that the ringing of his mobile phone would disturb other people in the room. He deliberately lowered his movements and turned sideways to answer the phone. At the same time, he whispered to VaX beside him: "I'll go out to answer a call and I'll be back soon. You sit down first."

VaX nodded slightly, said nothing, and still maintained his posture of sitting quietly with his head bowed.

Lin Shi quickly left the VIP area and walked outside the VIP room to answer the phone.

Not long after, a figure sat down next to him again.

He didn't look, thinking that Lin Shi had left and returned.

But he didn't expect that the other party would come slightly closer, lean over and say something in his ear.

VaX's body froze, and he suddenly looked back, only to see the other person's back leaving.

He sat stiffly on the spot, unable to recover for a long time.

"What's wrong with you?"

Lin Shi, who came back after answering the call, held the phone and looked at him doubtfully.

"No, it's okay."

VaX hurriedly moved his head to hide the shock in his eyes, and his voice couldn't stop shaking.

Lin Shi did not explore too much. At this time, the large screen playing the first and second male stages randomly on the stage gradually dimmed.

The next second, the lights in the entire venue suddenly went out.

In the darkness, someone whispered: "It's begun."

The huge venue instantly fell into darkness, the noise gradually subsided, and the 1,600 spectators fell silent in tacit agreement.

After a few seconds of darkness, a bright light suddenly pierced the darkness and landed precisely in the center of the stage.

In the third public performance, Guan Liu, the mentor of this show, led his group Flame on stage.

This is the most popular masterpiece of their group. The prelude of the music explodes instantly and the rhythm is very powerful.
